name: Luke Young
biography: is a security researcher from the frozen plains of Minnesota who has spent his last three summers escaping to the much warmer Bay Area as a security intern for various tech companies, most recently as part of the Uber product security team. He presented at DEF CON 23 on the topic of exploiting bitflips in memory and has investigated a variety of well-known products and network protocols resulting in numerous CVE assignments and recognition in security Hall of Fames. He is currently attempting to balance earning his undergraduate degree with maintaining his position as one of the top 10 researchers on Bugcrowd.
